tool_schemas.name: list-databases
tool_schemas.description: Lists databases in the specified workspace, optionally filtered by parent_page_id and archived/status, and returns a sorted, cursor-paginated collection with up to limit items and a next cursor when more results are available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when any ID does not match the required pattern, when limit is outside 1–100, or when archived and status are provided but conflict; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the workspace or its databases, and NOT_FOUND if the workspace (or provided parent page) doesn’t exist. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to list databases for.

parent_page_id.description: If provided, only return databases whose parent is this page.

archived.description: If provided, filter databases by archived flag.

status.description: If provided, filter databases by status.

limit.description: Maximum number of databases to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor to continue listing.

tool_schemas.name: query-database
tool_schemas.description: Queries a database and returns a cursor-paginated list of matching pages, applying the provided filter and sorts, starting at start_cursor and returning up to page_size results plus a next cursor when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when database_id is invalid, page_size is outside 1–100, or the filter/sorts payload is malformed (e.g., missing required sort fields); raises NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist and FORBIDDEN if you can’t read it. Raises CONFLICT if the database is archived/deleted and cannot be queried, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

filter.description: Optional query filter object (passed through to the database query engine).

property.description: Database property name to sort by.

page_size.description: Maximum number of pages to return from the database query.

tool_schemas.name: create-database
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new database under parent_page_id and returns the created database object including its schema, icon/cover, and inline setting. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required fields are missing, IDs are malformed, or properties_schema is invalid/unsupported; raises NOT_FOUND if the parent page does not exist and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to create content in that page. Raises CONFLICT if the parent page is archived/deleted and cannot accept new databases, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

parent_page_id.description: Parent page ID under which to create the database.

is_inline.description: Whether the database is inline on the parent page.

tool_schemas.name: update-database
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing database’s metadata (title/description/icon/cover), schema, and/or archived/status flags, returning the updated database object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when database_id is malformed, when no updatable fields are provided, when properties_schema updates are invalid, or when archived/status contain an unsupported combination; raises NOT_FOUND if the database does not exist and FORBIDDEN if you lack edit access. Raises CONFLICT when attempting a refused state transition (e.g., updating schema of an archived database) and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get_page
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a page by ID and returns its metadata and properties (not its content blocks); to read the page body, list block children using the page’s root block. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when page_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND when the page does not exist, and FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to the page. Raises CONFLICT if the page is deleted and cannot be retrieved, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: create-page
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new page under either a parent page or parent database (based on parent_type) and returns the created page object including properties and optional icon/cover. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when parent_type is missing/invalid, when the corresponding parent ID is missing or malformed, or when properties don’t match the target database schema; raises NOT_FOUND if the specified parent does not exist and FORBIDDEN if you cannot create pages there. Raises CONFLICT if the parent container is archived/deleted or otherwise cannot accept new pages, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

parent_type.description: Type of parent container for the new page.

parent_page_id.description: Parent page ID (required when parent_type is 'page').

parent_database_id.description: Parent database ID (required when parent_type is 'database').

properties.description: Page properties payload (e.g., database properties when creating in a database).

tool_schemas.name: update_page
tool_schemas.description: Updates a page’s title, properties, icon/cover, and/or archived/status flags, returning the updated page object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when page_id is malformed, when no updatable fields are provided, or when properties payload is invalid for the page’s database schema; raises NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist and FORBIDDEN if you lack edit access. Raises CONFLICT when attempting a refused state transition (e.g., modifying properties of a deleted page) and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-block
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single block by ID and returns the block object (type and type-specific data), without automatically expanding its children. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when block_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND when the block does not exist, and FORBIDDEN when you don’t have access to the block’s parent page/database. Raises CONFLICT if the block is deleted and cannot be retrieved, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-block-children
tool_schemas.description: Lists child blocks for the given parent block and returns a cursor-paginated collection of blocks, starting at start_cursor and returning up to page_size, optionally including archived/deleted children when include_archived is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when block_id is malformed, page_size is outside 1–100, or start_cursor is invalid; raises NOT_FOUND if the parent block does not exist and FORBIDDEN if you can’t view it. Raises CONFLICT when the parent block type cannot have children, and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

block_id.description: ID of the parent block whose child blocks will be listed.

page_size.description: Maximum number of child blocks to return in one page.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing children.

include_archived.description: Whether to include archived/deleted child blocks in results.

tool_schemas.name: append-block-children
tool_schemas.description: Appends one or more new child blocks to the specified parent block and returns the updated children result (including the newly created blocks). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when block_id is malformed, children is empty, a child block is missing type, or a type/data payload is invalid for the specified block type; raises NOT_FOUND if the parent block does not exist and FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to edit the parent. Raises CONFLICT when appending is refused (e.g., parent is archived/deleted or does not allow children) and RATE_LIMITED when quota is exceeded.

block_id.description: ID of the parent block to append new child blocks to.

children.description: List of child block objects to append.

data.description: Type-specific block payload (e.g., rich text, media URL, code language, etc.).

children.description: Optional nested child blocks to create under this new block.

type.description: Type of nested child block being created.

block_id.description: ID of the block to update.

data.description: Type-specific block payload to replace/patch the existing block data.

has_children.description: Whether the block has child blocks (server may also compute this).

type.description: Block type (typically unchanged; provided when changing block type is supported).

query.description: Free-text query to match against titles and/or content.

filter.description: Optional constraints on what objects to return.

object_type.description: Restrict results to only pages or only databases.

workspace_id.description: Restrict results to a specific workspace.

status.description: Restrict results by search index status.

page_size.description: Maximum number of results to return in one page.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous search response.

page_id.description: ID of the page to list comments for (page-level comments).

block_id.description: ID of the block to list comments for (block-level comments).

discussion_id.description: Restrict results to a specific discussion thread ID.

page_size.description: Maximum number of comments to return in one page.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing comments.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include deleted comments in results.

page_id.description: ID of the page to retrieve all comments for (page-level and block-level across the page).

page_size.description: Maximum number of comments to return in one page.

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response to continue listing comments.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include deleted comments in results.

page_id.description: ID of the page to attach the comment to (for page-level comments).

block_id.description: ID of the block to attach the comment to (for block-level comments).

discussion_id.description: Existing discussion thread ID to reply within; omit to start a new discussion.

parent_comment_id.description: Parent comment ID to create a threaded reply under.

rich_text.description: Rich text content for the comment.

tool_schemas.name: update-block
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing block’s content and returns the updated block object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required update fields are missing/invalid or the block type cannot accept the supplied fields, NOT_FOUND if the block ID does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the parent page/database, and CONFLICT if the block is archived/deleted or the requested change is not allowed for the block’s current state.

tool_schemas.name: search
tool_schemas.description: Searches across accessible pages and databases by title and/or content and returns a paginated list of matching objects (results plus next_cursor and has_more for pagination). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid query/filter/sort inputs, FORBIDDEN if the workspace or requested scope is not accessible, and RATE_LIMITED when search quota is exceeded.

tool_schemas.name: get-comments
tool_schemas.description: Returns a paginated list of comments for a given page or block, including threaded discussions where applicable (results plus next_cursor and has_more). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if neither/invalid target identifiers are provided, NOT_FOUND if the target page/block does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the target.

tool_schemas.name: get-all-page-comments
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves all comments associated with a page by aggregating comments on the page itself and on every block within the page, returning the combined set (internally paging through block/comment listings as needed). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid page ID, NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the page, and RATE_LIMITED if the underlying comment/block retrieval exceeds quota.

tool_schemas.name: create-comment
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new comment on a page or on a specific block, or posts a reply into an existing discussion thread when discussionId is provided, and returns the created comment. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the body is empty/invalid or when the target identifiers are missing/inconsistent (e.g., both page and block omitted), NOT_FOUND if the target page/block or discussionId does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you don’t have access to the target, and CONFLICT if the target is archived/deleted or comments are not allowed in its current state.

tool_schemas.name: get-database
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single database by id and returns its full database object (metadata, schema, icon/cover, inline setting, and archived/status). Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when database_id is malformed; NOT_FOUND when the database does not exist or is not visible in the caller’s workspace; FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks access to the database.

tool_schemas.name: get-page
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single page by id and returns the page object (properties and metadata only; does not include block children). Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when page_id is malformed; NOT_FOUND when the page does not exist or is deleted/not visible in the caller’s workspace; FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks access to the page.

tool_schemas.name: update-page
tool_schemas.description: Updates a page’s properties and/or archived/status flags and returns the updated page object. When the page belongs to a database, validates property updates against the database schema and rejects incompatible changes. Refuses with VALIDATION_ERROR when page_id is malformed, when no updatable fields are provided, or when properties are invalid; NOT_FOUND when the page does not exist; FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to edit the page.

properties.description: Updated page properties payload (merged/replaced per server rules).

title.description: Optional new page title (if supported for the page’s parent type).

status.description: Lifecycle status transition for the page. 'deleted' is terminal.

metadata.name: Notion
metadata.description: This backend stores a Notion-like workspace graph of databases, pages, blocks, and threaded comments, plus query/search activity for pagination and filtering.
